# Parser edge cases for TestBashDifferential (internal/engine/shell)
# Command lines are separated by lines holding only "---"
# Bash never runs them
---
echo $'a\'b' .env
---
cat .en\
v
---
echo `echo a\`b\`` && cat .env
---
echo "$(echo ")")" .env
---
: ${x:=$(cat .env)}
---
a[$(cat .env)]=1
---
echo $((1 + $(cat .env | wc -l)))
---
x=$(case y in y) cat .env;; esac)
---
cat <<"E"OF
$(rm -rf x)
EOF
---
cat <<END
$(cat .env)
END
---

	cat .env
	E
---
time -p cat .env
---
function f { cat .env; }; f
---
coproc c { cat .env; }
---
select x in a; do cat .env; done
---
for ((i=0; i<1; i++)); do cat .env; done
---
[[ $(cat .env) =~ ^(a|b)$ ]]
---
echo ${x//\//a} .env
---
echo if then .env
---
ls |& cat .env
---
cat .env &> out
---
exec {fd}<.env
---
cat <<< $'a\nb' .env
---
echo a#b .env # c
---
echo {a..c} .env
---
x="${y:-"a b"}" cat .env
---
case .env in (*) cat .env;; esac
---
echo $"loc" .env
---
cat -- .e\nv
---
eval 'cat .env'
---
trap 'cat .env' EXIT
---
alias x='cat .env'
---
cat >| out .env
---
{ cat .env; } 2>&1
---
( cd src && cat ../.env )
---
! cat .env
---
cat .env; exit
---
if cat .env; then :; elif ls; then :; else :; fi
---
while read -r l; do echo "$l"; done < .env
---
declare -a arr=( .env "$(cat .env)" )
---
local x=$(cat .env)
---

---

printf '%s' "$(<.env)"

}

.env

b' .env
